purpose: Inspect privacy-preserving road-hazard clusters and supporting evidence for the workspace-selected vehicle.
primaryGoal: Assess hazard severity, confidence, observation coverage and recency without exposing precise locations or implying navigation or vehicle control capabilities.

identity.mount: Lazy component within SafeRoute; source registration confirmed, browser mounting unverified.

dataSources.queryBehavior: Query key includes vehicle, limit and offset. Positive vehicle enables query. AbortSignal forwarded to request. Existing inherited retry/stale policies are untouched.
dataSources.knownBackendBehavior: Service reads ListHazardEvidence over a rolling 90-day interval with a 1000-row input limit; omits uncorrelated coarse cells; derives confidence; sorts by last_seen descending; paginates clusters; returns quality, limitations and generated_at. Evidence source labels security_events_and_signal_log. Repository SQL and deployed responses were not inspected.
dataSources.units: Confidence is a percentage; observations are counts; coarse_cell is an identifier, not coordinates. No physical measurement conversion is performed.

dataSources.endpoint: useVehicles dependency; its HTTP contract was not traced in this bounded audit.
dataSources.sourceOwner: Workspace selection hook and existing selectedVehicle store
dataSources.behavior: URL/path selection, persisted selection and fleet fallback; page consumes vehicleId without introducing a local picker.
dataSources.workspace: web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:22-78,165-179 establishes range=false and vehicle=true for the assigned route. Current backend owns its fixed observation interval; do not invent client-only date filtering.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing formatter preference bridge and web\src\lib\dateFormat.ts
dataSources.behavior: Counts and percentages use saved precision/locale; timestamps use centralized helpers. Numeric source values and wire timestamps remain unchanged.

components.name: PageLayout
components.role: Existing PageContainer adapter; full-width min-w-0 container; shell owns workspace controls.

components.name: InsightPanel
components.role: Domain panel composing LayoutCard, SourceContent and useDataState.

components.name: EvidencePanel
components.role: Domain owner of quality, supporting sources, limitations and unsupported capability explanations.

components.name: SourceContent
components.role: Loading, fatal error, empty and retained content presentation with retry.

components.name: Table
components.role: Semantic key/value matrix with bounded horizontal scrolling; not a sortable/exportable dataset.

components.name: Pagination
components.role: Caller-owned server pagination, first/previous/current/next/last and direct destination input.

components.name: FadeIn
components.role: Existing entrance motion using reduced-motion preference.

components.name: AlertBanner, Badge, Text, EmptyState, KVList
components.owner: Existing category barrels and EvidencePanel imports
components.role: Privacy notice, textual severity, typography, source emptiness and quality matrix. Individual implementations not all inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Feature-local white-alpha article frame duplicates the evidence-source frame in EvidencePanel:82; both bypass neutral surface tokens.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing Card/LayoutCard surface or existing neutral surface utilities; keep articles and evidence details. No new HazardCard surface system.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Hazard cards stack then use md two-column and xl three-column viewport grids; EvidencePanel stacks then lg three-column. Table owns horizontal scrolling; Pagination uses container-aware controls.

issues.detail: Grid follows viewport breakpoints rather than allocated PageLayout container width; card flex headers and coarse identifiers do not set min-w-0 or explicit long-text wrapping. Narrow shell allocation and long backend strings are source-visible overflow risks, not observed failures.
issues.fix: Use existing CardGrid/container strategy with min-w-0 and non-lossy wrapping; exercise long hazard types, identifiers and severity at all contract widths.

sourceStrengths: h3 hazard headings through Text as override
Severity is exposed as text, not color alone
Shared Pagination has named native controls and aria-current
FadeIn respects the existing motion preference

issues.detail: Every cluster matrix repeats the same generic accessible table name, so table navigation does not identify which hazard/coarse cell the matrix belongs to.
issues.fix: Use a localized source-specific table label including hazard type and coarse cell, or associate the matrix with a unique hazard heading; keep all four row headers.

states.initialLoading: Hazard query passes into InsightPanel and SourceContent skeleton. EvidencePanel is independent and immediately renders no-data descriptions.
states.empty: Resolved empty hazards retain panel shell and threshold explanation plus source retry. No selected vehicle shows a selection prerequisite. Empty evidence retains EmptyState.
states.fatalError: Hazard panel isolates fatalError and offers retry; evidence panel does not receive the failure state.
states.retained: InsightPanel retains rows on refresh failure/paused fetch and SourceContent provides a generic retained warning and retry.
states.offline: Initial paused hazard query gets unresolved/paused copy rather than claiming resolved emptiness. Retained paused data maps to retained state.
states.unknown: Missing quality currently says unsupported even before query resolution; missing evidence says none returned; absent limitations says no additional limitations.

issues.detail: EvidencePanel receives only optional payload, not the hazard query trust state. During first load, fatal failure or no selection it displays unsupported quality/no returned evidence/no additional limitations as though the source answered. Retained refresh failure is not annotated within this second panel.
issues.fix: Extend the existing EvidencePanel with an optional query/DataState presentation contract and source-specific prerequisite state; pass the same hazard query while preserving independent section shells and every unsupported explanation.

issues.detail: The DataState adapter is reduced to a five-state SourceContent enum; last-success time, refreshing flag, blocked refresh and refresh-error details are not surfaced. Generic retained copy cannot distinguish offline from failed refresh or show freshness.
issues.fix: Compose the existing trust warning/presentation mechanisms with retained payload, updatedAt and retry; preserve fatal-only replacement and avoid introducing another trust registry.

visualIssues.detail: border-white/[0.08] and bg-white/[0.025] hardcode white-alpha presentation across themes. The same pattern exists at EvidencePanel:82. No page neon, glow or saturated gradient was found by the bounded source inspection.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral existing surface/border tokens without changing saved palette/theme settings; retain semantic danger/warning badges and subdued hierarchy.

architectureIssues.detail: Pagination state survives workspace vehicle changes. Switching from page N to a vehicle with fewer clusters sends the old offset. If items is empty, InsightPanel hides its children including Pagination, so the user cannot return to page 1 through the table controls. Shared Pagination clamps displayed page but does not correct caller-owned query offset.
architectureIssues.fix: Scope/reset pagination to selected vehicle and recover when returned total makes the offset invalid; retain 18-row server paging, exact offsets and all navigation actions.

architectureIssues.detail: formatRelative emits hardcoded English 'just now' and 'm/h/d ago'; the page's localized label does not localize relative recency. Evidence timestamp formatting defaults to browser locale rather than explicit formatter preference.
architectureIssues.fix: Extend the existing date formatting owner with locale-aware relative output and consume existing saved locale/timezone policy; do not add a page-specific date formatter.

order: Localize recency and improve unique table naming
priority.reason: Source-confirmed trust and pagination risks precede restrained presentation modernization; no runtime failure is claimed.

requiredSharedChanges.name: EvidencePanel source-state integration
variants: Existing domain evidence panel, not a replacement global panel
usedBy: Existing advanced-intelligence EvidencePanel consumers; exact other consumer list not audited
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Keep all three evidence sections and unsupported statements visible; unknown availability cannot become unsupported/empty; refresh failure never removes retained metadata.

requiredSharedChanges.name: InsightPanel retained trust details
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Show source freshness and cause-specific trust without replacing retained data or creating a competing state vocabulary.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Locale-aware relative timestamp formatting
dependsOn: Existing formatter preference bridge and localization policy
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Localized recency with unchanged wire UTC values and safe missing timestamps; no competing formatter.

competingImplementations.evidence: RoadHazardMeshPage.tsx:71 and EvidencePanel.tsx:82 define white-alpha frames despite existing Card/LayoutCard/Table surface ownership.
competingImplementations.decision: Reuse existing owners; no new component or palette.

competingImplementations.evidence: Page consumes useSelectedVehicle and renders no local range or vehicle controls.
competingImplementations.decision: Preserve header ownership; fixed backend rolling interval does not authorize a second picker.

competingImplementations.evidence: InsightPanel already uses useDataState and SourceContent; EvidencePanel currently bypasses query annotation.
competingImplementations.decision: Extend existing composition, not a second query/error/state pipeline.

actions: Pagination first/previous/current/next/last and direct page jump
Workspace vehicle change through existing shell
dataBehavior: Preserve coarse-cell-only privacy boundary; never map identifiers to coordinates
No route reconstruction, automatic rerouting or vehicle commands
No inferred hazard-free claim for empty results
Preserve raw percent/count/timestamps and SI wire/cache data
Preserve source ordering, evidence flattening per loaded page, query keys, enablement, cancellation, inherited retry and caching
Keep real zero distinguishable from unavailable values
Preserve all localized privacy/evidence/unsupported explanations and saved formatter/theme/motion preferences
Do not invent exports, charts, live telemetry or backend range support
preservation.existingTestEvidence: AdvancedIntelligenceClosure.test.tsx:237-257,282-296 contains mocked retained-refresh, exact offset, zero and coarse-cell matrix/privacy assertions. InsightPanel.test.tsx checks recovery and informational emptiness. Tests were inspected, not executed.

evidenceLimits.countsScope: Assigned root TSX only; regex/static checks are not full semantic compliance or runtime proof.
